items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: I've done several with him, and he's always called me for a date.

ctx.x: I got that out of a book. It says you were on a record with her, 'Me and My Chauffeur', and 'I've Got Too Many Blues', on Decca. And with Sam Price -- I know Sam, but of course he made --
Yeah, I did those things for Decca.
-- 'Blow, Katie, Blow', and 'It's All Right, Jack.'
